query: I spent the whole morning trying to perfect my matcha latte recipe at home, I kept adjusting the ratio of matcha powder to oat milk and even tested three different sweeteners to get the taste just right. On my way to the pet cafe later, my little corgi got so excited when he saw a golden retriever across the street that he pulled so hard on the leash I almost dropped my tote bag. I also spent ten minutes on the bus playing that new tile-matching puzzle game everyone's been talking about, and I finally beat the 127th level that I've been stuck on for three whole days. Now I'm having a ton of trouble with my phone service: airplane mode is turned on right now, my network preference is set incorrectly, my Wi-Fi calling isn't working properly, my APN MMS settings are broken, my apps have broken storage permissions, I've exceeded my data usage limit, my SIM card feels like it's not seated right, and I'm currently abroad with roaming turned off. I need to figure out how to fix all these issues so my phone works normally again.
